changelog: Fixes the WiFi tab's Forget button being hidden whenever the current connection was set up outside this app's own Connect flow. Fixes the setup/hotspot QR overlay not appearing after a later 'Reset to Default Settings' if the 'show QR on boot' option had been turned off - being genuinely stranded on the setup hotspot with no other way back into settings now always shows the QR for at least 5 seconds regardless of that toggle (using the configured duration instead if it's set longer than 5s). The original first-boot 2-minute countdown window is unaffected.
